channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: File Mover Express: AWS Releases Open-Source Tool for S3 File Transfers
item.description: AWS has recently released File Mover Express, an open-source application under the Apache 2.0 license for transferring large files between local systems and Amazon S3. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Spring News Roundup: First Release Candidates of Boot, Framework, Data, Security, Modulith, AI
item.description: There was a flurry of activity during the week of October 19th, 2026, highlighting: first release candidates of: Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Spring Data, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring for GraphQL, Spring Session, Spring… (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Enlightenment 0.28.0 Release
item.description: Their alternative to Qt/GTK (EFL) also got a new release: https://www.enlightenment.org/news/2026-10-31-efl-1.29.0 Comments (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle no longer requires automatic minor version upgrades for JVM, Spatial, Locator, and OLAP options
item.description: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for Oracle now lets you turn off automatic minor version upgrades on new and existing DB instances that use the JVM, Spatial, Locator, or OLAP option. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS WAF announces automatic SDK integration for Amazon CloudFront distributions
item.description: AWS WAF announces automatic SDK integration for Amazon CloudFront distributions. When you enable it, CloudFront adds the script tag for the AWS WAF JavaScript SDK to the HTML it serves, with no change to your application code, build… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports versioning and aliasing for flows
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now supports versioning and aliasing for flows and flow modules, simplifying how you build, test, and deploy customer experience flows while minimizing impact to live end-customer traffic. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Managed Prometheus collectors now support Amazon MSK consumer-group metrics
item.description: Managed Prometheus collectors now support Amazon MSK consumer-group metrics for Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus and Amazon CloudWatch . (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Glue Data Catalog now supports Apache Iceberg table optimization in the US West (N. California) Region
item.description: AWS Glue Data Catalog now supports automatic table optimization for Apache Iceberg tables in the US West (N. California) Region. Apache Iceberg is an open table format that delivers fast query performance over large tables in data lakes. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon SageMaker AI inference now supports GPU partitioning for real-time endpoints
item.description: Amazon SageMaker AI inference now supports GPU partitioning, enabling you to run several models on a single GPU instead of dedicating a whole accelerator to each one. (1 source: aws)
